data.description:
ShapesXR is a design and collaboration platform for remote teams.
"Best Collaboration Tool" Auggie Award, Augmented World Expo 2021.

“ShapesXR Revolutionizes XR Development” - Forbes.

In ShapesXR anybody can start creating in 3D without prior experience within minutes. You can design and prototype your immersive app, invite others to co-create in real-time, or present your ideas using ShapesXR storyboard feature. You can also share your creation with anybody without a VR headset via Web, the Unity plugin or just a picture for your 2D deck.

ShapesXR has powerful MR creation capabilities that especially shine on Meta Quest Pro. It supports avatars with eye and mouth tracking for an enhanced social presence, full-color passthrough for higher fidelity UI and UX design in MR, and Stylus controllers for commenting and quick sketching.

ShapesXR allows product owners, business leaders, and designers to finally start thinking and creating spatially together for the future of VR, AR and MR.

Improvements

4.19.1 -> 4.192 

Improvements

 - Added chroma key controls for the Figma Viewer

4.19.0->4.19.1

- SXR-6749: Fixed issue where Follow mode in VR cannot be stopped if started by a web user.

- SXR-6802: Resolved issues with attached groups breaking after exiting Play mode.

- SXR-6808: Fixed workspace-related problems for free users.

- SXR-6812: File names are no longer cut off in the Move pop-up and file preview.

- SXR-6823: Scene switching via the stick now functions correctly.

- SXR-6816: Fixed handling of objects with pivots that do not correspond to the bounds center.

4.0.18->4.19.0

**`FEATURES`**

-  Scene switcher UI was returned.

-  Implemented a progress indicator.

**`IMPROVEMENTS`**

-  Resurrected Pico platform functionality.

-  "Show avatars" is now OFF by default.

-  Refactored scene systems to prepare for migration to state-based scenes.

-  Polished Figma view for improved usability.

-  Improved Bindings Updater to address issues with object offsets during controller movement.

-  Supported scene changes using the new Scenes Menu on the controller during object grabbing or Gizmo use.

**`BUG FIXES`**

- Fixed exception and freeze when adding stages with objects to a collaborative session without an internet 
connection.

- Menu no longer jumps when the user moves using teleport.

- Exception fixed while grabbing certain objects

- Interactions no longer stay in the background when the object is transferred to the scene.

- Fixed exception after pausing

- Move button in import preview is no longer available after the trial ends.

- Spaces now open in the correct mode instead of always defaulting to MR mode.

- Fixed incorrect scene indexing on the controller in Play mode.

- Commenters and viewers can no longer change space names.

- Interactions are no longer duplicated when duplicating or copy-pasting a scene.

- Group bounds are no longer shown during interactivity scene previews.

- Scene numbers are now synced correctly in Same Page mode between versions 18 and 19.

- Scene numbers are now synced on interactivity cards.

- Fixed issue where controllers appeared "empty" when pointing at objects with interactivity in Play mode.

- Hover effect now works for viewers and commenters in Play mode.

- Background notification now displays when changing spaces.

- Viewpoints are now correctly handled as part of scenes and the background.

- Added pop-up explaining why the Paste button is inactive for free users in the selection menu.

- Trial notifications now display correctly for Pro and Community Pro plans.

- Fixed "VIEW-ONLY" message always appearing.

- Resolved pop-up overlapping issues.

- Added notifications about the 14-day trial in workspaces.

- Objects beyond the workspace boundary can no longer be grabbed.

- Undo/Redo functionality is now blocked after permission changes.

- Trial notifications now correctly display for Team plans when storage is full.

- Resolved overlap issues between plan and view pop-ups.

- Fixed when Camera tool label  is active in the Toolswitcher.

- Corrected text for free users when attempting to create a new space.

- Avatar visibility now updates dynamically during presentations.

- Trial notifications now correctly appear in the Share panel for Enterprise plans.

- Paid plans can now add more than 10 scenes.

- Participants can now see the presenter’s avatar.

- Fixed missing trial notifications in workspaces.

- Education users can now see the Projects tab in the app.

- Fixed outline display for the current scene.

4.0.17->4.0.18f3


FEATURES

- Licenses changes

- Introduced Figma View/Prototype support.

- Introduced Follow Mode for the Web Editor.


IMPROVEMENTS

- Added a new "Community Pro" license, similar to the current Pro/Professional license.

- Removed "Back to 1.0" and "Revert to 1.0" buttons.

BUG FIXES

- Fixed exception after pausing 

- Viewpoint is now visible after pausing when pasted from the clipboard.

- Viewpoints are no longer pasted as regular objects.

- Disabled material copy/paste functionality for viewpoints to prevent exceptions.

- Disabled material copying for space links, holonotes, web views, and viewpoints.

- Controller and hand positions are now correctly copied when copying a viewpoint.

- Fixed when export button in the scene context menu is no longer blocked.

-Spaces now start in VR by default.

-Added laser straightening during snapping.

-Iteration of UX polishing.

-Rotation snapping now works with the laser pointer.

-Added color dropper button in the Paint tool.

-Returned duplicate toolbit on the dominant hand.

-The audio spatializer now works for objects attached to the body.

-Tool switches to selection when an asset is grabbed from the asset menu.

-The hand menu now opens when an object is selected.

-Teleport to viewpoint on Play is now available in the Prototyping section.

Fixes:

-Fixed laggy object snap when rotation snap is enabled.

-Model preview no longer spawns in the center when scale factor is set to auto.

-The delete button is now displayed for project spaces.

-Fixed when line from interactivity to the object is visible in play mode.

-Color change for multi-selected objects with groups is now functional.

-Snapping to surfaces now works correctly with newly grabbed procedural cubes.

-Paint tool ray is no longer interrupted by furniture in Room-scale mode.

-Objects are no longer snapped to the wrong side of the floor.

-Interactivity for deleted objects no longer refers to them.

-Fixed when toolbar opens on the Text tool for the first time.

-Text color can now be changed via the Paint tool.

-VR and real controllers now match correctly for Quest Pro and Quest 3.

-Frame drops while selecting are fixed.

-Interactivity is now cleared from the object when the option that uses it is changed.

-The Delete interactivity button now responds in all cases.

-Selection with modification pressed now works correctly.

-Space now opens immediately when using the "Open in VR" feature
